assets.name: 2장 — 달러와 기관
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production pixel-art sprite sheet for finance action roguelite The Liquidation of Penny. TRUE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND. Exactly 4 columns by 6 rows in a perfectly uniform grid, no borders, no labels. Each cell one isolated full-body monster, chunky deliberate pixel art, bold dark outline, coarse visible square pixels, 3-tone shading, small-sprite readability, no blur. Each row repeats SAME character across 4 poses: idle, attack anticipation, strong melee attack, recovery. Facing RIGHT, side view or 3/4 side. Center each sprite within its cell with transparent safety margin, align feet at 85 percent of cell height. Never cross cell boundaries. Six rows TOP TO BOTTOM: shield: giant walking green dollar banknote folded into a heavy shield with claw feet; drone: floating paired dollar and won coins with two opposite exchange arrows forming wings; bomb: round coin purse with red margin-call fuse; ghost: monstrous white glove hand emerging from a navy institutional suit cuff; rubble: squat walking bundle of banknotes with teeth; enforcer boss: huge clenched institutional fist with navy cuff, gold dollar cufflink and a tiny vault face. Boss occupies same cell boundaries, broader muscular silhouette. Currency and recognizable company-logo motifs are integral body shapes, not text labels. No scene, floor shadows, typography, extra icons, watermarks. Square overall canvas, uniform cells. All six rows and four columns must be complete.
